items.title: Benchmarking large language model agents with reproducible protocols
items.text: A research group publishes reproducible evaluation protocols for large language model agents. The write-up covers task suites, grading rubrics, statistical uncertainty in reported accuracy and comparison with earlier evaluation harnesses.

items.title: Language model red-team evaluation results
items.text: Safety researchers report red-team evaluation results for a deployed language model. Their methodology documents attack prompts, refusal rate measurement, remediation follow-up and open review notes.

items.title: Robotics benchmark suite for manipulation tasks
items.text: This benchmark suite measures manipulation tasks for robot arms. It documents standardized task variants, success metrics, baselines and per-hardware calibration so laboratories can compare results.

items.title: Signed attestations for dependency supply chains
items.text: An engineering team describes provenance attestations for their dependency supply chain: each build publishes signed software bill of materials metadata, so downstream users can verify component origins and revoke compromised artifacts.

items.title: Empirical scaling laws across modalities
items.text: A preprint studies empirical scaling laws for model performance as parameters, data and training compute grow across text, vision and robotics modalities, with fitted curves and released measurement logs.

items.title: What training compute budgets mean for robot learning
items.text: An engineering blog connects recent power-law performance research to robot learning practice: fixed training compute budgets, data efficiency trade-offs and why curriculum changes can beat additional parameters.

items.title: Acme announces Atlas 2 controller
items.text: Acme announces the Atlas 2 controller with safety self-tests and factory calibration. Early adopter laboratories report stable operation under load.

items.title: Acme recalls Atlas 2 controllers
items.text: Acme recalls the Atlas 2 controller after a safety defect in its actuator watchdog. The advisory documents affected serial ranges, remediation steps and a firmware replacement recall history.

items.title: Acme ships Atlas 3 controller with added safety redundancy
items.text: The Atlas 3 controller ships with hardware safety redundancy and a documented remediation bulletin covering earlier recalls. Acme publishes migration guidance for laboratories upgrading controllers.

items.title: Serving a classifier on constrained hardware
items.text: This write-up evaluates 4-bit weight compression for on-device inference latency, accuracy trade-offs and energy cost on constrained hardware.

items.title: Reproducible evaluation protocols for robot perception benchmarks
items.text: A peer-reviewed paper proposes reproducible evaluation protocols for robot perception benchmarks, including dataset versioning, metric definitions and uncertainty reporting.

items.title: Sim-to-real transfer evaluation for robot learning
items.text: The paper evaluates sim-to-real transfer for robot learning policies and reports protocol details, randomization ranges and field comparisons.

items.title: Orion 3 community workshop recap
items.text: A community workshop recap collects speculation and notes about the Orion 3 controller, including unverified claims and slides posted by attendees.

items.title: Seasonal fashion collection drop
items.text: A retailer announces a seasonal clothing collection with limited runs.

items.title: Advertising campaign for a household gadget
items.text: A marketing campaign promotes a household gadget without technical detail.

items.title: Neighborhood bakery opens second location
items.text: Local news reports a bakery opening a second storefront downtown.

items.title: Community bulletin for local updates
items.text: A community bulletin collects local updates, event notices and meeting times.
